note: Typed typelines now post the moment they are submitted (Go, Enter, or the new ➤ button), the same way drags do, with the outbox only as a retry that any tab can pump. A new or unknown command (the 'new command → this agenda' path) is still sent, even if it was only applied locally. The typeline box has a visible ➤ submit button at the right edge that works with the Android keyboard open. The code column shows the last send error instead of a bare sending…. If the CLI topic post fails, the page retries then falls back to the drag topic.
